instruction: Like all the venmo transactions of the ongoing year to and from my coworkers.
notes: Representative instance: two coworker contacts (coworker-a, coworker-b) with three year-to-date transactions (txn-a1, txn-a2, txn-b1); at runtime the number of coworkers and transactions is whatever phone.search_contacts / venmo.show_transactions return, and the object lists scale accordingly. The target relationship 'coworker' is a domain constant since the task fixes it. phone.search_contacts is modeled as one call (query=relationship='coworker') whose effect (contacts-searched coworker) unlocks the static contact-email facts of coworkers; phone.get_current_date_and_time unlocks the start-of-year datetime used as min_created_at. venmo.show_transactions is called once per coworker email (user_email + min_created_at) and asserts (transactions-found ?p), enabling venmo.like_transaction for every transaction with that coworker (extra ?p parameter links the record to its lookup). supervisor.complete_task takes the transactions as non-API parameters with pairwise inequality so its precondition exactly mirrors the goal (all transactions liked) without quantifiers; it is called with status='success' and no answer. Usernames come from supervisor.show_profile (phone number for phone, email for venmo).
